scope: Bound container log growth for every Docker Compose service and confirm associated Playwright diagnostic paths do not retain verbose traces or raw HTML indefinitely.

acceptance.all_compose_services_rotated: PASS - Docker Compose renders json-file logging with max-size 10m and max-file 5 on all nine services: postgres, redis, migrate, api, mock, worker, scheduler, source-worker and document-worker. Each service log is bounded to approximately 50 MiB before rotation.
acceptance.regression_reproduced: PASS_AS_RED - the new rendered-config test failed before production config because all nine services lacked a logging stanza.
acceptance.playwright_trace_storage: PASS - existing live-feedback test confirms trace start/stop are not used and trace.zip is not created; existing feedback session cleanup test confirms old managed diagnostics are pruned on new session creation.
acceptance.raw_html_storage: PASS - prior repository source inventory found no product HTML snapshot writers; prior evidence docs/evidence/2026-10-07-feedback-screenshot-content-masking.json records that result.

validation.observation: Rendered Compose config had no logging field on any of the nine services.

validation.command: docker compose --profile fixture config --format json (synthetic required env values)
Disposable no-network Docker run using json-file max-size=1m/max-file=2; emitted 50 x 100000-character lines; docker inspect plus docker logs; removed container

environment.docker_engine_runtime: PASS - isolated no-network synthetic container proved actual json-file rotation; existing personal MJobs services were not altered

limitations: The real MJobs Compose services were not restarted or recreated; exact production 10 MiB × 5 settings were verified in rendered config, while Docker Engine rotation behavior was exercised with a smaller disposable 1 MiB × 2 cap.
No Playwright raw trace or product HTML snapshot writer exists in inspected product paths; this slice adds rotation to all Compose service logs.
